{{Top|leg}}
A '''pheroreceptor''' was part of a [[Bith/Legends|Bith's]] anatomy. They were epidermal folds located beneath the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] that trapped and analyzed air molecules, translating it into a chemical analysis for the Bith's [[Brain/Legends|brain]].
